newsitem.title: USA: FAA found problems at ValuJet recently as Dec - NYT.
newsitem.headline: FAA found problems at ValuJet recently as Dec - NYT.

text.p: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration discovered problems with ValuJet's system for assuring airplane safety as recently as December, The New York Times reported on Friday.
In interviews to the Times on Thursday, FAA officials said the carrier still met Federal safety standards, however.
Seven months ago, a ValuJet plane crashed in the Everglades, killing everyone on board.
The FAA last month told ValuJet that it found the company could not demonstrate that all its auditors had been properly trained and the agency said some audits were incomplete, the newspaper said.
